programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: Across Utah on a Harley, Part 3
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 3

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: Across Utah on a Harley, Part 4
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 4

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: In 2011, the European Boss Hoss Rally took place in the Pullman City western town in Germany. We show the highlights of this event where nearly 160 V8 monster bikes were gathered. (Part 1 of 2)

programme.title: KTM 990 Adventure
programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

programme.title: Kymco People GT 300i
programme.desc: 10 or 16 inch wheels - is this really just a question of taste? Motorvision reveals the advantages and disadvantages of the big wheel motorcycle People GT 300i, made by Kymco.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We present to you historic image and film documents from the Porsche 550 RS Spyder. And: how the Audi Quattro shocked its competitors with its driving dynamics.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: High-tech turbo cars from the wild 1980s are reunited at the Salzburgring race track. Also: the Lancia Beta Monte Carlo, a small Italian two-seater with mid-engine offers classic car driving pleasure at a low entry price.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: With the M3, BMW brought race car technology to the road. In addition: 120 years of Mercedes-Benz motorsports history. And: turbo power in the DTM. The Ford Sierra RS Cosworth taught its racing competition the meaning of fear.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Audi Quattro
programme.desc: Advantage through Technology on rally tracks. The Audi Quattro shocks opponents.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: What's the perfect winter car for ultimate fun in the snow? The BMW X6 M and the Lada Niva have to prove themselves in the Ulten Valley in South Tyrol in Italy. Plus: High speed, adrenaline and pure action at the Snow Mobile show in Austria.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The search for the perfect winter car is still on. Patrick Simons puts the Subaru WRX STI and Audi RS6 Clubsport from MTM through their paces. Plus: With the MP4-12C, McLaren brings a successor to their famous F1 model to the streets.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Jetta is a big seller in the United States. With the sixth generation, Volkswagen wants the model to be successful with European car buyers, too. Plus: we take a look at the new Ford Focus and the BMX X3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Patrick Simon reviews the Porsche Cayenne S Hybrid. Below its hood is a 333 HP V6 engine and a 47 horsepower electrical motor. Plus: Upcoming racing driver Chris Bauer at the FIA GT1 championship at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Test driver Patrick Simon wants to take part in the 24 Hours of Le Mans and reviews his LMPC car. Plus: we compare the Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0 TDI to the Kia Sportage 2.0 CRDI.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Sometimes great things come in small packages like with the Mini John Cooper Works. Also: drifting in the Volkswagen Jetta at the Ice Experience in Sweden. In addition: the Steinbeisser Trophy. And: the Mercedes-AMG CLS 63.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.sub-title: Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG
programme.desc: Hosts Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite petrol heads from the Middle East to bring their tuned cars to the 'The Walk' at Jumeirah Beach and have it rated in the categories speed, style and sound. Whoever receives the most points, wins a one night stay for two people at this glamorous Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. On this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro and Mercedes SLS AMG try to impress.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: If you want to see out-of-this-world, customized or tuned luxury vehicles or posh cars you need to go to 'The Walk', the glamorous boulevard of Jumeirah Beach. Put Your Car on TV invites car owners to have their vehicles judged by Saif Hattawi. The person with the most points wins a special treat from the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the presented cars are a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: People from the Middle East are crazy about their cars. On Put Your Car on TV they have the chance to present their tuned vehicles and judged. They are awarded points based on speed, style and sound and the car owner with the most points, wins a special treat for two from the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the competitors are a Nova SS, a special Honda Acord and a car full of crystals.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: Special: 24h of Le Mans - Track Days
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S
programme.desc: Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The compact cars Mercedes A45 AMG Performmaster and MTM Audi RS3 R are loud, fast and extremely honed. In addition we examine the myth of Ferrari and take a look behind the scenes of the Rolls Royce Bespoke production.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The Route 66 from Chicago to Santa Monica is the most legendary road in the world. Following the old Highway you can experience the myth behind this former arterial road. Plus: A double-pack of GTR with the Nissan GTR and Mercedes-AMG GT R.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: With its Model S, American carmaker Tesla wants to establish electric engines in the full-size class. For the first time it is possible to attain driving ranges over 400 kilometers. And: with its Panamera Sport Turismo, Porsche taps into a new market.

programme.title: Toyota GT86 J-Sport
programme.desc: With the Toyota GT 86 from J-Sport, it is noticeable that the company's roots lie in racing. The fans' wish to give the Japanese racer significantly more power nevertheless remained unfulfilled.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Customised cars from the desert: in Ron's Garage in California, rolling works of art are created according to customer wishes. Plus: Mercedes-Benz transforms the G-Class into the ultimate G 63 AMG 6x6 survivalist's dream. And: the Brabus B63.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: MTM turns the RS6 into the RS6 R Clubsport. Also: Stefan Kalläne pimped a Volkswagen Lupo to the extreme. At the Tuning Expo Saarbrücken he looks for the hottest gadgets in the car tuning scene.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Scirocco GT-R1 from Mathilda Racing, the Bentley GT3 R and the Volkswagen Golf R. The Scirocco is a complete conversion. The Bentley GT3 R is the street version of the current GT3 racer. And the Golf R is the most powerful Golf ever.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: In Dubai, the legendary super sports car police fleet is on the hunt for speeders and parking violators. Also: the Audi S8 MTM Talladega R. And: the Alpina D5 on the race track.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The BMW 3 Series, Nissan 370 Z or Citroen DS3 are usually considered everyday cars. But in the M version, as a Nismo or as a Musketier, things get down to business in terms of performance.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: The ice course on Lungauring, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 in winter training. Twelve participants in six Evos were taught the art of drifting with a four-wheel drive car. We accompanied a student on his first drifting experience.

programme.title: Toyota Corolla Levin
programme.desc: In 1970, the second generation Corolla was released in Japan. The sporty model version „Levin“, similar to the Volkswagen Golf GTI among the Corollas, was only made available in Japan and the United States.
